verdict.rationale: Pilot is a managed bookkeeping and accounting service. A user-configurable rules or automation layer, such as categorization rules or event-triggered alerts, is a fair question for a finance platform with a customer portal, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no way for users to define their own rules: 'Custom workflows and reporting' is an unexplained service-tier line item. The automation customers describe (transaction classification via integrations, the Gusto credit being applied automatically) is done by Pilot, not set up as rules by the user.
